---
title: "Neuropsych PDF Table Extractor"
subtitle: "Template for extracting score tables from neuropsychological test PDFs"
format: 
  html:
    toc: true
    theme: cosmo
server: shiny
params:
  test_code: "wrat5"
  test_name: "WRAT-5"
  default_page: 2
  score_type: "standard_score"
  test_type: "npsych_test"
  domain: "Academic Skills"
---

```{r}

#| include: false

options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 50 * 1024^2)

  "scale", "raw_score", "score", "ci_95", "percentile", "range",

  "absort", "description", "result"

# Load lookup table
lookup_path <- "~/Dropbox/neuropsych_lookup_table.csv"
if (file.exists(lookup_path)) {
  lookup_table <- read.csv(lookup_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  lookup_table <- data.frame(
    scale = character(), test = character(), test_name = character(),
    domain = character(), subdomain = character(), narrow = character(),
    pass = character(), verbal = character(), timed = character(),
```

## Instructions

1. **Select Test** - Choose your neuropsychological test from the dropdown
2. **Upload PDF** - Upload the test report PDF
3. **Configure Extraction** - Select page and map columns
4. **Download** - Export cleaned CSV for your workflow

---

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar

selectInput(
  "test_code",
  "Select Test Battery",
  choices = names(test_configs),
  selected = params$test_code
)

hr()

fileInput("file", "Upload PDF Report", accept = c(".pdf"))

numericInput("pages", "Page(s) to Scan", value = params$default_page, min = 1, max = 50)

selectInput(
  "extraction_method",
  "Extraction Method",
  choices = c("stream" = "stream", "lattice" = "lattice"),
  selected = "stream"
)

hr()

uiOutput("table_selector_ui")

hr()

actionButton("extract_btn", "Extract Tables", class = "btn-success")
downloadButton("download_csv", "Download CSV", class = "btn-primary")
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill

uiOutput("test_info_ui")
hr()
verbatimTextOutput("status")
hr()
uiOutput("column_mapping_ui")
hr()
h4("Processed Data")
DTOutput("results_table")
hr()
h4("Raw Extraction (Debug)")
tags$details(
  tags$summary("Click to expand raw table"),
  DTOutput("raw_table")
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server

safe_numeric <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", as.character(x))))
}

current_config <- reactive({
  test_configs[[input$test_code]]
})

output$test_info_ui <- renderUI({
  cfg <- current_config()
  wellPanel(
    h5(cfg$name),
    tags$small(paste(
      "Domain:", cfg$domain, "| Score Type:", cfg$score_type, 
      "| Test Type:", cfg$test_type
    ))
  )
})

raw_tables <- eventReactive(input$extract_btn, {
  req(input$file)
  withProgress(message = "Extracting tables...", {
    tryCatch({
      tabulapdf::extract_tables(
        file = input$file$datapath,
        pages = input$pages,
        method = input$extraction_method,
        output = "matrix"
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(paste("Error:", e$message), type = "error")
      NULL
    })
  })
})

output$table_selector_ui <- renderUI({
  req(raw_tables())
  n <- length(raw_tables())
  if (n > 1) {
    selectInput("table_idx", paste("Table (", n, "found)"),
                choices = seq_len(n), selected = 1)
  }
})

selected_idx <- reactive({
  if (!is.null(input$table_idx)) as.integer(input$table_idx) else 1
})

candidate_df <- reactive({
  req(raw_tables())
  df <- as.data.frame(raw_tables()[[selected_idx()]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df[] <- lapply(df, trimws)
  colnames(df) <- paste0("V", seq_len(ncol(df)))
  df
})

output$column_mapping_ui <- renderUI({
  req(candidate_df())
  df <- candidate_df()
  cols <- colnames(df)
  
  make_choices <- function(cols, df) {
    setNames(cols, sapply(cols, function(c) {
      preview <- paste(head(na.omit(df[[c]]), 2), collapse = ", ")
      paste0(c, " (", substr(preview, 1, 30), "...)")
    }))
  }
  
  choices <- make_choices(cols, df)
  none <- c("None" = "None")
  cfg <- current_config()
  
  # Score label based on type
  score_label <- switch(cfg$score_type,
    "t_score" = "T-Score:",
    "scaled_score" = "Scaled Score:",
    "Standard Score:"
  )
  
  wellPanel(
    h5("Column Mapping"),
    fluidRow(
      column(4, selectInput("col_scale", "Scale:", choices = choices, selected = cols[1])),
      column(4, selectInput("col_raw", "Raw Score:", choices = c(none, choices),
                            selected = if (length(cols) >= 2) cols[2] else "None")),
      column(4, selectInput("col_score", score_label, choices = choices,
                            selected = if (length(cols) >= 3) cols[3] else cols[1]))
    ),
    fluidRow(
      column(4, selectInput("col_ci", "95% CI:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
      column(4, selectInput("col_percentile", "Percentile:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
      column(4, selectInput("col_range", "Range/Category:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None"))
    ),
    if (cfg$score_type == "standard_score") {
      fluidRow(
        column(4, selectInput("col_grade", "Grade Equiv:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
        column(4, selectInput("col_gsv", "GSV:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
        column(4)
      )
    }
  )
})

processed_data <- reactive({
  req(candidate_df(), input$col_scale, input$col_score)
  
  df <- candidate_df()
  cfg <- current_config()
  
  result <- data.frame(
    scale = trimws(df[[input$col_scale]]),
    score = safe_numeric(df[[input$col_score]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Add optional columns
  if (!is.null(input$col_raw) && input$col_raw != "None") {
    result$raw_score <- safe_numeric(df[[input$col_raw]])
  }
  if (!is.null(input$col_ci) && input$col_ci != "None") {
    result$ci_95 <- gsub("–|—", "-", trimws(df[[input$col_ci]]))
  }
  if (!is.null(input$col_percentile) && input$col_percentile != "None") {
    result$percentile <- safe_numeric(df[[input$col_percentile]])
  }
  if (!is.null(input$col_range) && input$col_range != "None") {
    result$range <- trimws(df[[input$col_range]])
  }
  if (!is.null(input$col_grade) && input$col_grade != "None") {
    result$grade_equiv <- trimws(df[[input$col_grade]])
  }
  if (!is.null(input$col_gsv) && input$col_gsv != "None") {
    result$gsv <- safe_numeric(df[[input$col_gsv]])
  }
  
  # Filter valid rows
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(scale), scale != "", !is.na(score))
  
  # Add metadata
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      test = input$test_code,
      test_name = cfg$name,
      domain = cfg$domain,
      test_type = cfg$test_type,
      score_type = cfg$score_type
    )
  
  # Join with lookup table for subdomain, narrow, pass, verbal, timed, absort, description
  if (nrow(lookup_table) > 0 && input$test_code %in% lookup_table$test) {
    lookup_cols <- lookup_table |>
      dplyr::filter(test == input$test_code) |>
      dplyr::select(scale, subdomain, narrow, pass, verbal, timed, absort, description) |>
      dplyr::distinct()
    
    if (nrow(lookup_cols) > 0) {
      result <- result |>
        dplyr::left_join(lookup_cols, by = "scale")
    }
  }
  
  # Ensure all standard columns exist
  for (col in c("subdomain", "narrow", "pass", "verbal", "timed", "absort", "description", "result")) {
    if (!col %in% names(result)) result[[col]] <- NA_character_
  }
  
  # Apply neuro2 ranges if available
  if (neuro2_available && exists("gpluck_make_score_ranges", where = asNamespace("neuro2"))) {
    result <- neuro2::gpluck_make_score_ranges(result, test_type = cfg$test_type)
  }
  
  # Reorder columns to standard order
  result |>
    dplyr::select(any_of(standard_col_order))
})

output$status <- renderText({
  if (is.null(raw_tables())) return("Click 'Extract Tables' after uploading PDF")
  paste0("✓ ", length(raw_tables()), " table(s) | ", nrow(processed_data()), " records processed")
})

output$raw_table <- renderDT({
  req(candidate_df())
  datatable(candidate_df(), options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 5))
})

output$results_table <- renderDT({
  req(processed_data())
  datatable(processed_data(), 
            options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10, dom = 'Bfrtip', buttons = c('copy', 'csv')),
            extensions = 'Buttons')
})

output$download_csv <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() paste0(input$test_code, "_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
  content = function(file) write.csv(processed_data(), file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
)
```
